cultural.vision_reason: The photo documents a Hopi kachina plaza dance, showing rows of dancers in traditional masks, headdresses, aprons, and body ornaments—directly matching the claimed Hopi ethnicity and ceremonial dress/practice.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white)
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white); a group of Hopi people participating in a public plaza dance, two groups of dancers are participating; the long haired kachina standing in a row, all wearing bearded hair and feather headdresses, aprons, arm ornaments and leg ornaments; and the kachina mana standing in a row opposite the long haired kachina, all wearing cloaks, leggings, moccasins, feathered headdresses, and carrying pouches with seeds in; two dancers wearing different dance costumes are standing amongst the row of long haired kachina, they are wearing fur and feather headdresses, fur skirts, and moccasins; Arizona, United States of America 
Gelatin silver print
